title: gRPC Interop Harness Configuration Schema
description: Declarative schema for gRPC cross-language interoperability test cases, language endpoints, capabilities, and backward-compatibility release matrix.

$schema.description: Path or URI to this JSON Schema file.

capabilities.description: Canonical list of all positive feature and transport capabilities recognized by the harness.

prod_servers.description: Mapping of production server nicknames to target hostnames for cloud_to_prod suites.

prod_server_capabilities.description: Capabilities supported by production interop target servers.

server_order.description: Canonical ordering of server languages for cloud_to_cloud execution and CLI choices.

http2_badserver_client_order.description: Canonical ordering of languages with HTTP/2 negative test clients.

alts_language_order.description: Canonical ordering of languages supporting ALTS transport security.

test_cases.description: Unified test case definitions and required capability sets grouped by suite.

standard.description: Standard gRPC interoperability test cases run in cloud_to_cloud and cloud_to_prod.

auth.description: Authentication and credential interoperability test cases run in cloud_to_prod_auth.

http2_client.description: HTTP/2 client framing and TLS test cases.

http2_server.description: HTTP/2 negative and data-frame padding server test cases across 8 ports.

language_defaults.description: Baseline settings and capabilities inherited by all entries in languages unless overridden.

languages.description: Per-language endpoint definitions layered on top of language_defaults.
Per-language release tags, runtime mappings, and historical release overrides.

capability.description: A positive gRPC interop feature or transport capability.

commandSpec.description: Command invocation specification: either a token list, a single executable string, or a structured template object.

command.description: Base command tokens preceding formatted arguments.

args_mode.description: How runtime CLI arguments are passed to the command.

arg_template.description: Format string template for joined_flag or extract_port_template modes.

port_regex.description: Regular expression used to extract server port in extract_port_template mode.

standardTestCase.description: Standard gRPC interoperability test case specification.

capabilities.description: Capabilities required by both client and server to run this test case.

cloud_to_prod.description: Whether this test case is eligible for cloud_to_prod and matrix suites.

extra_cloud_to_cloud_flags.description: Additional client CLI flags appended when running in cloud_to_cloud.

name.description: Auth test case identifier passed to --test_case.

capabilities.description: Capabilities required by client and server for this auth test case.

transport_security.description: Transport security / credential type used by this test case (defaults to tls).

requires_compute_engine_creds.description: Whether this test case always requires GCE metadata server credentials.

uses_service_account_key.description: Whether this test case requires a service account key file via flag or env.

uses_service_account_key_when_flag.description: CLI flag attribute name that conditionally enables service account key file env var.

uses_oauth_scope.description: Whether to pass --oauth_scope to the client.

uses_default_service_account.description: Whether to pass --default_service_account to the client.

requires_compute_engine_creds_capability.description: Client capability that causes this test case to require GCE credentials.

uses_default_service_account_capability.description: Client capability that causes this test case to pass --default_service_account.

http2ClientTestCase.description: HTTP/2 client interop test case specification.

capabilities.description: Capabilities required by client and server.

http2ServerTestCase.description: HTTP/2 negative server test case specification.

client_capabilities.description: Capabilities required on the client endpoint.

server_capabilities.description: Capabilities required on the HTTP/2 test server endpoint.

client_kind.description: Whether this test uses the dedicated http2_interop client or standard grpc_client.

grpc_client_test_case.description: Underlying gRPC client test_case name when client_kind is grpc_client.

transport_security_override.description: Transport security override when invoking grpc_client against the HTTP/2 server.

languageDefaults.description: Default configuration values inherited by all language endpoints.

in_runner_languages.description: Whether the language is registered in _LANGUAGES by default.

included_in_all_clients.description: Whether the language is included when -l all is specified.

supports_server.description: Whether the language provides an interop server by default.

docker_supported.description: Whether the language runs inside Docker when --use_docker is enabled.

auth_credentials_mode.description: Default mechanism for passing service account credentials (GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS env vs --service_account_key_file flag).

client_capabilities.description: Baseline client capabilities inherited by languages that do not explicitly override client_capabilities.

server_capabilities.description: Baseline server capabilities inherited by languages that do not explicitly override server_capabilities.

languageConfig.description: Configuration for a single gRPC language or HTTP/2 endpoint.

safename.description: Docker-safe short name (defaults to language key).

in_runner_languages.description: Whether to expose this endpoint in _LANGUAGES.

included_in_all_clients.description: Whether to include this client in -l all.

supports_server.description: Whether this endpoint supports running as a server.

docker_supported.description: Whether this endpoint supports Docker execution.

is_http2_target.description: Whether this entry represents the dedicated Http2Client/Http2Server target.

auth_credentials_mode.description: Credential delivery mode override (env or flag).

client_cwd.description: Working directory relative to container/repo root for client invocations.

server_cwd.description: Working directory relative to container/repo root for server invocations.

http2_cwd.description: Working directory relative to container/repo root for HTTP/2 negative client invocations.

global_env.description: Environment variables set for all invocations of this language.

cloud_to_prod_env.description: Additional environment variables set for cloud_to_prod invocations.

client_cmd.description: Command specification for running the interop client.

server_cmd.description: Command specification for running the interop server.

http2_client_cmd.description: Command specification for running the HTTP/2 negative test client.

client_capabilities.description: Full replacement list of client capabilities (overrides language_defaults.client_capabilities).

add_client_capabilities.description: Capabilities added to the inherited baseline client_capabilities.

remove_client_capabilities.description: Capabilities removed from the inherited baseline client_capabilities.

server_capabilities.description: Full replacement list of server capabilities (overrides language_defaults.server_capabilities).

add_server_capabilities.description: Capabilities added to the inherited baseline server_capabilities.

remove_server_capabilities.description: Capabilities removed from the inherited baseline server_capabilities.

http2_server_client_capabilities.description: Client capability view when instantiated in the Http2Server role.

http2_client_server_capabilities.description: Server capability view when instantiated in the Http2Client role.

matrixReleaseOverride.description: Release-specific or range-specific overrides for historical matrix releases.

patch.description: Files touched by git_repo.patch when building this historical release tag.

runtimes.description: Runtime image variants overriding default_runtimes for this release or range.

testcases_file.description: Historical matrix testcase profile identifier overriding <lang>__master.

matrixLanguageConfig.description: Release matrix configuration for a language.

repo.description: Git repository URL cloned when building release images (defaults to https://github.com/grpc/grpc.git).

default_runtimes.description: Default container runtime names for this language (defaults to [lang]).

build_from_release_tag.description: Whether build_interop_image.sh is invoked from the checked-out release tag (defaults to true).

root_env_var.description: Environment variable pointing to the checked-out repository root (defaults to GRPC_ROOT).

releases.description: Ordered list of release version tags tested in the backward-compatibility matrix.

release_overrides.description: Map of release tag ('vX.Y.Z') or inclusive tag range ('vA.B.C..vD.E.F') to ReleaseInfo overrides.
